## ⬇ Download

**Just want to play?** Download **[Fox-Launcher-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/Fox-Launcher-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe)** below and run it. That's the whole thing — it installs Java, Minecraft, Fabric, and the Fox mod for you, then keeps itself up to date.

> Windows may show a SmartScreen warning the first time (the build isn't code-signed). Click **More info → Run anyway**.

### Which file do I click?

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| **`Fox-Launcher-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe`** | 👈 **The installer. Click this.** |
| `kitsune-client-{{VERSION}}.jar` | The mod by itself — only if you install Fabric manually (advanced). |
| `latest.yml`, `*.exe.blockmap` | Used by the launcher's auto-updater. Ignore. |
| Source code (zip / tar.gz) | The repository snapshot. Ignore unless you're building from source. |
